title: HiFun: a Hierarchical Framework for Efficient Functional Dexterous Manipulation Learning
authors: Linyi Huang, Guowei Huai, Weibin Liu, Shulong Jiang, Ping Tan, Weixuan Zhang, Hui Zhang, Jie Song

tldr.zh: HiFun 采用上下两层 RL 策略：下层在手把手示教参考上学习手指关节残差，修正和恢复接触；冻结下层后，上层通过 DMP 数据初始化与人在环 RL，学习机械臂末端运动及下层技能的激活程度，共同完成精细臂手操作。
tldr.en: HiFun uses two RL policy layers: a lower-level policy learns finger-joint residuals around kinesthetic demonstration references to correct and restore contact; after freezing this policy, an upper-level policy initialized with DMP data and refined through human-in-the-loop RL learns end-effector motion and hand-skill activation strength for precise arm–hand manipulation.

evaluation_scope.zh: 下层采用真机残差 SAC，结合观测、指尖力与示教参考输出 12 维手指关节残差，加到参考姿态；接触异常时参考可回退以恢复接触。上层采用 RLPD／SAC，输出 6 维末端运动增量＋连续激活权重 α，用 α 在中性手姿与下层修正后的技能手姿间插值，不直接探索全部手指关节。先训练并冻结下层，再训练上层；执行时两者共同运行，下层权重固定但根据当前观测修正手指。双头 critic 分别引导机械臂对齐和技能激活时机，IAW 按价值优势加权学习人类纠正。Franka Research 3 搭配 Sharpa 或 XHand，六项工具操作／受限空间取物任务各 50 次主评测，平均成功率 98.3%；每任务最多一小时指上层在线微调，另需手技能学习、示教、DMP 数据和奖励分类器准备，评测限于训练工作区内的位姿随机化。
evaluation_scope.en: The lower level uses real-robot residual SAC to output 12 finger-joint residuals added to a kinesthetic reference, conditioned on observations and fingertip forces; the reference can rewind after contact disruption. The upper level uses RLPD/SAC to output a 6-D end-effector increment and continuous activation weight α, interpolating between a neutral hand pose and the corrected skill pose rather than exploring every finger joint. Train and freeze the lower policy before upper-policy training; both run at execution, with fixed lower-level weights but observation-dependent finger corrections. Separate critic heads guide arm alignment and activation timing; IAW weights imitation of human interventions by estimated advantage. Six functional tool-use/constrained-retrieval tasks on Franka Research 3 with Sharpa or XHand have 50 main trials each and 98.3% average success. The one-hour per-task cap covers upper-level online fine-tuning, with additional hand-skill learning, teaching, DMP data and reward-classifier preparation; pose randomization remains within the trained workspace.
